data.acceptance:
1. `thimble peer add/remove/list` round-trips peers.toml.
2. `thimble peer join <ssh-target>` bootstraps a new leader from an existing one via rsync over ssh; refuses to overwrite without --replace.
3. README has an "Onboarding a new leader" walk-through.
4. Tests cover all flag paths and edge cases.
5. No new third-party Go deps.
